technical.summary: Strong short-term bullish setup with golden cross and volume spike, but lack of ADX confirmation and price below 200-EMA limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: FCX shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 96 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (27/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and mixed with no conviction signal from senior members.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (324.0) indicates extreme market stress, and Materials sector faces credit stress; earnings in 96 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross + three white soldiers + 15x volume spike create textbook short-term bullish reversal setup in extreme fear environment (27/100 fear-greed), offering contrarian entry near support at 26.70.
debate.key_bear_argument: Fundamental collapse (score 2), macro crisis conditions (inverted yield curve, VIX 324, credit stress), price below 200-EMA, no ADX trend confirmation, stochRSI overbought, and earnings risk in 96 days create asymmetric downside risk that overwhelms technical setup.
